name: day1-tornado-corridor-experiment-v1
product: Day 1 tornado (06Z HRRR f06-30, valid 12Z-12Z), probability of a tornado report within 25 miles
domain: v0.7 regional box (-100..-75 E, 30..45 N), samples within 25 miles of US land (14,940)

data.development: the 96 2022-23 cohort dates, CONUS extraction run 44577990940 (Day 1 features and Storm Events tornado labels; label 255 = unknown, dropped)
data.diagnostic_only: 2024: the 323 NadoCast benchmark days (extraction runs 44942885255 + 44961446546; NadoCast from score run 44961880902)
data.sealed: 2021 (96 dates in research/severe/conus-v1/twostage-verification-2021.json) opened once only if the candidate passes; 2025 never

wider_features.base_meaning: each field's 24-h (f06-f30) maximum at a sample centre, already in the saved extraction
wider_features.neighbourhood: all samples of the saved 40,311-point CONUS grid (stride-5 HRRR, ~15 km) whose great-circle distance from the box sample is <= the radius, including the sample itself
wider_features.edges: No padding, no zero fill, no extrapolation. Neighbourhoods reaching outside the box use the real CONUS-grid samples there (box + pinned land samples + box-rectangle ocean samples). Where the grid ends (open ocean outside the box rectangle, Canada, Mexico) the statistic uses only the samples that exist. Measured before fitting: 99.5% (50 mi) and 98.5% (100 mi) of box samples have >= 80% of a full disk; minimum 46 of 90 and 181 of 362 samples (coastal corners). The per-sample sample count is recorded, not used as a feature.
wider_features.transform: asinh(x) for UH, SRH and SBCAPE statistics; raw for shear and reflectivity; then standardized with training-fold mean and s.d.

arms.a_refit: v0.7 recipe refit: the 34 v0.7 inputs, standardized, penalized logistic; monotone logistic (Platt) calibration on inner out-of-fold scores, as the v0.7 recipe
arms.b_recalibrated: arm a's logistic, with isotonic recalibration on inner out-of-fold scores instead of Platt (recalibration only)
arms.c_corridor: the 34 v0.7 inputs + the 20 wider features, same penalized logistic, isotonic recalibration on inner out-of-fold scores

nesting.outer: 6 month-grouped folds (phase2_study.fold_of: whole calendar months, every fold spans all seasons); each outer fold's months are unseen by fitting, tuning and calibration
nesting.inner: within the training months, the remaining 5 month-groups: penalty chosen by inner held-out log loss from (1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1) for each feature set; calibration fitted on inner out-of-fold scores
nesting.evaluation: all comparisons use the outer held-out predictions only

live_threshold_proposal: chosen inside training folds only: (1) 5% on the calibrated scale (calibration fitted in training months); (2) the arm-c threshold whose inner out-of-fold false-alarm area equals arm b's 5% inner out-of-fold area. Both are reported on held-out months; neither decides pass/fail.

pass_criteria_c_vs_b.1_matched_area_hits: hits at matched false-alarm area (arm b's pooled held-out 5% area; arm c thresholded to the same false-alarm count) >= 1.10 x arm b, with the paired date-bootstrap 95% lower bound of (c - b) hits > 0
pass_criteria_c_vs_b.2_left_out: report points left out of an otherwise correctly placed corridor (missed, within 100 km of that arm's own flagged area that day, at matched area) reduced by >= 25% vs arm b, with the paired 95% lower bound of (b - c) > 0
pass_criteria_c_vs_b.3_brier: Brier(c) - Brier(b) < 0 with the paired 95% interval entirely below 0
pass_criteria_c_vs_b.4_no_regression: wrong-place misses (c) <= 1.05 x (b) and no-signal misses (c) <= 1.05 x (b) (point estimates, same definitions as the diagnosis: flagged area >= 10 samples, 100 km)
pass_criteria_c_vs_b.5_reliability: for arm c held-out bins [2,5), [5,10), [10,15), [15,30), [30,100]% with >= 20 report points: |mean forecast - observed| <= 0.30 x observed
pass_criteria_c_vs_b.bootstrap: 5000 paired draws of development dates, seed 20261124

also_reported: arm a vs b vs c Brier, AUC, reliability, hits/misses at 2% and 5%, matched-detection false-alarm area
2024 diagnostic: arms b and c refit on all 96 dates, applied to the 323 benchmark days, compared with NadoCast at matched area (never deciding)

rules: development day with the most tornado report points in the box (held-out predictions, arms b and c)
development day with the most arm-b left-out report points (held-out, arms b and c)
2024-12-28 diagnostic: arms b, c and NadoCast

if_pass: freeze arm c (fit on all 96 dates, hashes committed), then verify once on the sealed 2021 list against arm b and live v0.7 with the same metrics
if_fail: 2021 stays sealed; the scorecard shows each criterion's value and margin
unchanged: live v0.7 map, RRFS/NBM collector, 2025 sealed
